panels.title: When things change
points: Use the emergency fund, not riba debt

blocks.answers: Needs: £650 + £180 + £25 + £250 + £120 = £1,225. Left: £1,500 - £1,225 = £275. For example sadaqah £30, saving £150, wants £95 = £275. Extend: the £200 car repair could come from wants (£95) and saving (£105), keeping needs and sadaqah.

keywords.def: a plan for income and spending
a cost that stays the same each month, like rent
a cost that changes, like food
